test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: The population of a village increases by 0.2% in the first year, it increases by 0.4% in the second year, and due to some disease, it decreases by 0.4% in the third year. What will be its population after 3 years, if in the beginning of the first year it was 2000 (rounded off to two decimal places)?
solution:
**Concept:**

To find the population after n years,

Multiply the initial population by (1 + annual growth rate)ⁿ.

**Solution:**

After the first year: 2000 × (1 + 0.002) = 2004.

After the second year: 2004 × (1 + 0.004) = 2012.02.

After the third year: 2012.02 × (1 - 0.004) = 2003.97.

**Therefore, the population of the village after 3 years will be approximately 2003.97.**
